source_interpretation: Appendix Table 5 nctx=3000 is two independent 1500-context acquisitions, one A-optimal and one random. Exact synthetic mu designs the policy; acquired labels fit the estimator nuisance out of fold.
fixed_command: uv sync --frozen && uv run python repro/run_all.py
requirements: Design separate Borda, BT, and Rank Centrality A-optimal policies from exact synthetic probabilities at beta=2000.
Acquire independent n=1500 A-optimal and n=1500 random datasets.
Fit global binary LightGBM nuisances with two-fold cross-fitting and the paper's 30-draw, three-fold tuning procedure inside every training fold.
Run 15 deterministic v1 repetitions and report MSE times 100.
Require A-optimal mean MSE below random for all three GARS and overlap with all six v1 numerical intervals.
Require exact budgets, optimal variance objectives, nonnegative influence weights, and rejection of a budget-matched inverted-information control.
